scope: Two completed native measurement harnesses; no new tests claimed by aggregating five sessions

pilot.limits: Generated native encoder/file-input comparison only. No capture/control/transport, actual wire/relay traffic, OS helper/GPU/power/baseline-subtracted app CPU or physical endpoints. CPU/RSS cover the probe process including I/O, initialization and warmup. Metric comparisons are not complete text/codec admission.

manifest.scope: Generated pixels only. Original RGB thin region is retained before source 4:2:0 conversion. No screen, UI, input, codec or performance qualification.

fixture.scope: Reused assets are identified by their byte hashes; current source/font hashes do not establish their historical generation environment.
